I be farmer for South West here, I don dey farm this maize for many years on this small land wey I rent. The rain dey come two times so I plant early maize now, and I go mix am with cassava and small melon like I always do. Money no plenty and I no get credit, but fertilizer dey important for maize if I wan see better harvest, so I go buy small NPK and urea if I fit, and I go add the small poultry droppings wey I gather. I go work am myself with my wife and children, and only call small hired hand for weeding if the grass too much.
